convert_rae_checkpoint_to_diffusers: run the CLI to convert an RAE decoder checkpoint from a HuggingFace repo to diffusers AutoencoderRAE format
resolve_decoder_file: build a RepoAccessor to resolve and locate a decoder checkpoint file in a HuggingFace repo or local path
unwrap_state_dict: create a function that unwraps a nested state dict by stripping model, module, or decoder prefixes from keys
remap_decoder_attention_keys: refactor RAE decoder attention keys to match diffusers AutoencoderRAE attention layout with to_q, to_k, to_v mappings
extract_latent_stats: summarize a stats checkpoint object to extract latents mean and standard deviation tensors for normalization
